title: Patient Care Desk Guidance: Renewal Requests on Prescriptions
content:
When a patient's prescription under Kestrel Prescriptions needs a new authorization to continue therapy, Kestrel sends the prescriber a renewal request on the terms below.

## When a request may be sent

- A renewal request is sent only where the class sends renewal requests and the prescription is in received, active or expired status.
- The request reason is **no refills remaining** when the remaining refills are 0, and **expiring soon** when refills remain but today is within the class's renewal window before the expiration date.

## Spacing

A renewal request is sent no earlier than the previous request for this prescription plus the resend business days, counted in business days Monday to Friday excluding Kestrel's published holidays, the send date being day 0. The date of the previous request comes from the prescription's prescriber request history; the day the spacing ends itself qualifies.

| Previous request sent (resend after 2 business days, no published holiday in between) | Earliest next request | Too early |
|---|---|---|
| Monday | Wednesday | Tuesday |
| Thursday | the following Monday | Friday |

## Channel

- The request goes electronically when the prescriber's record shows electronic prescribing of controlled substances (EPCS) enabled or the class is non-controlled.
- It goes by fax only where the class permits fax and the prescriber cannot receive it electronically.
- Otherwise no request is recorded and the patient is asked to contact the prescriber.

## Frequency

No more than the class's limit of requests are sent per prescription in the rolling 30 days, the 30 calendar days ending today, today included.

## Replies

An approval arrives as a new prescription entered under the Prescriptions intake standard and is never recorded as a reply to the request; a denial is recorded against the request it answers and ends that request.

## Channel decisions (hypothetical prescribers)

| Class | Prescriber's record shows EPCS enabled | Class permits fax | Request |
|---|---|---|---|
| non-controlled | any | any | electronic |
| controlled | yes | any | electronic |
| controlled | no, and cannot receive electronically | yes | fax |
| controlled | no, and cannot receive electronically | no | none recorded; the patient is asked to contact the prescriber |
